source.hash_note: PUBLIC-CONSTANT: checksum of the supplied original artwork file
source.authorship: Original artwork coauthored by the user and their mother.

coordinate_system.contour_winding: positive signed area in image coordinates (clockwise on screen)
coordinate_system.contour_closure: implicit; final point is not repeated
coordinate_system.ordering: measured rings outer to inner, then clockwise starting at the top; groups do not generate geometry

color_canon.trace_note: Geometry only. No organizational or three-view recoloring has been applied.

method.foreground_rule: alpha>0; RGB projection on reference teal >=0.5; B-R>40; G-R>30
method.contours: Exact component pixel edges followed by measured-boundary RDP; never regular hexagons or radial reconstruction.
pixel_trace_limits: Source resolution is 820 x 821, not vector artwork.
JPEG/color-edge artifacts survive in supplied PNG; a documented 50% color coverage contour is used.
A 3D bevel or UV sampling may change apparent edge coverage; these measurements evaluate the flat trace only.

modeling_fidelity.method: RDP of the same measured pixel boundary with at most one original pixel deviation; no fixed side count and no per-cell IoU gate.
modeling_fidelity.resolution_limit: One pixel is a substantial fraction of each 8–14 pixel innermost cell. All cells remain present, but their modeled edges are approximations; consult per-cell overlaps and the unchanged reference contour.

unresolved.note: These innermost cells are separately resolved, but have only 8–14 foreground pixels each. Their original subpixel polygon corners cannot be inferred. All measured cells are retained; none are replaced with regular hexagons.
